rationale: Build on the current best quant-aware projection-EMA path with a minimal EvoNAS-style gated carryover transplant: repeat the final block once more with shared weights and a learned sigmoid gate. This keeps the exact int8 endgame unchanged, adds negligible size cost, removes the unused skip-count attribute, and tests whether one deeper gated tail pass can buy better final int8+zlib val_bpb within the Mac mini wallclock budget.
title: Tail-Block Gated Recurrence On Best Quant Path
